messages:
Carlos (AE): Quick ask from HarborCo: 2-week POC, three micro-flows (intent routing, note summarization, reply-tone). Need baseline prompt set, 100 gold examples per flow, and a headline cost by tomorrow. Can we scope minimal footprint? @Maya @Rina
Maya (SE): Yes. Plan: hosted baseline, Dedicated only if KMS/SSO blocking. I'll prepare 3 prompt templates and 100 gold examples each.
Ethan (Solutions Eng): Eval plan: run 100 samples/flow initially. Command: `./eval/run --suite harborco_minimal --n 100 --model redwood-hosted-v1`
Rina (PM): Proposed success gates: intent accuracy >= 0.74, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.56, tone accept >= 78% on blind 100-sample check, p95 latency <600ms. Midpoint sync day 5.
finance-bot: ballpark hosted_cost_2w = $X (using qps 1.8, peak 9, 270 tokens avg). Dedicated delta +40% estimate. Provide assumptions when sharing.
Maya (SE): Prompt sketches (short):
- intent_v1: "Choose one: billing, feature, bug, other. Return single label."
- summary_v1: "3-bullet summary focused on actions/outcome."
- tone_v1: "Rewrite reply: professional, concise, empathetic, <120 chars."
Maya (SE): I'll upload prompts + gold JSON to POC folder and ping this thread when ready.
Carlos (AE): Great. I'll tell the customer we can deliver baseline kit tomorrow and start next Mon. Thanks all.
